data.name: Ameeshaht
data.gender_notes: Ameeshaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Ameeshaht is the name of the honored wives of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). It is a name of respect and admiration for the women who dedicate their lives to their families and faith. The name Ameeshaht carries the meaning “Mother of the Believers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ameeshaht usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the believers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ameeshaht is also associated with the virtue of patience and perseverance, as exemplified by the wives of the Prophet.
data.etymology: Ameeshaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of the Believers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameeshaht total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_urdu.name: امیشحت

They were mothers, wives, and community leaders who played a vital role in spreading the message of Islam and establishing a model Islamic family. The name Ameeshaht thus represents the ideals of loyalty, dedication, and sacrifice, which are deeply embedded in Islamic culture.
